scripts._comment_dev: Runs from the build rather than the sources. `node --experimental-strip-types src/server.ts` cannot resolve this package's './config.js'-style specifiers back to .ts and dies with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND, so the previous watch-mode dev script did not start at all on Node 22+. Building first costs ~3s and works everywhere; use `dev:watch` if you want reload while editing.
scripts._comment_env: --env-file-if-exists loads the repo-root .env (gitignored) for local runs. Path is ../../ because npm runs workspace scripts with cwd set to the package dir. `-if-exists` matters: Cloud Run and CI have no .env and inject real env vars instead, and plain --env-file would abort the boot there. Real env vars always win over the file, so the deployed config is never shadowed.
